notes: SETUP > Sword: Classic, RPG menu or RPG battle -- the sword opens a retro command window: ATTACK, MAGIC (a burn), COMMANDER, INFECT, HEAL
Turn the knob to move the glove; tap the glove's row to choose (a tap on another row only moves the glove)
RPG battle: then who (HP beside each name, ALL FOES), how much, and the line the game says; the UNDO toast waits on the face
RPG menu: the window, then the usual pages already set to its kind
Drop the sword on a seat and the window opens aimed at it; SETUP > RPG window: Blue or Black
The sword also shows on one device with seats round the face, so the window can be tried without a table
